note: Written by hand, on purpose. A plausible draft that states a duration and a headcount the notes never gave. It is kept so the provenance and quantity checks can be watched holding a field back.

fields.text: Tile setting in unit B stopped when rain came in after lunch.

provenance.quote: rain after lunch, tile setting stopped in unit b

fields.text: The rain cost about two hours of work, and three inspectors signed off on the rough-in for unit A.

provenance.quote: inspector came by in the morning, signed off on the rough-in for unit a
